examples.title: EPANET Net3, L/s (SI)
examples.description: Litres per second, with metres and millimetres. An EPANET example at Novato, California, converted from gallons per minute, feet and inches, with the world map behind it: 92 junctions, 3 tanks and 2 reservoirs, no valves, about 8 km square. A 24-hour extended-period simulation, with a source trace from the Lake.

examples.title: EPANET Net3, gpm (US)
examples.description: Gallons per minute, with feet and inches. An EPANET example at Novato, California, with the world map behind it: 92 junctions, 3 tanks and 2 reservoirs, no valves, about 5 miles square. A 24-hour extended-period simulation, with a source trace from the Lake.

examples.title: EPANET Net2, L/s (SI)
examples.description: Litres per second, with metres and millimetres. An EPANET example at Branford, Connecticut, converted from gallons per minute, feet and inches: 35 junctions and 1 tank, with no reservoir, no pump and no valves, about 2 km by 4 km. Fluoride, a non-reactive substance, enters at one source.

examples.title: EPANET Net2, gpm (US)
examples.description: Gallons per minute, with feet and inches. An EPANET example at Branford, Connecticut: 35 junctions and 1 tank, with no reservoir, no pump and no valves, about 1 mile by 2 miles. Fluoride, a non-reactive substance, enters at one source.

examples.title: Elm Street Center, gpm (US)
examples.description: Gallons per minute, with feet and inches. Prescott Valley, Arizona: 17 junctions, 1 reservoir and 1 pump. A commercial site solved for fire flow on top of maximum day demand, at one moment in time, drawn over a site plan.
